payments_path = '/data/payments.xlsx'

print(beneficiaries.head())

# Load payments - find sheet names
xls = pd.ExcelFile(payments_path)

payments = pd.read_excel(payments_path, sheet_name='Disbursements')

payments.columns = [c.strip() for c in payments.columns]

payments['Beneficiary ID'] = payments['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()

payments['Status_clean'] = payments['Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()

merged = payments_paid.merge(beneficiaries, on='Beneficiary ID', how='inner', suffixes=('_pay','_ben'))

    (merged[donor_col].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Azim Premji Foundation') &

import pandas as pd
import re

payments_path = '/data/payments.xlsx'
beneficiaries_path = '/data/beneficiaries.csv'

beneficiaries = pd.read_csv(beneficiaries_path)
beneficiaries.columns = [c.strip() for c in beneficiaries.columns]
beneficiaries['Beneficiary ID'] = beneficiaries['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()

payments = pd.read_excel(payments_path, sheet_name='Disbursements', header=4)
payments.columns = [c.strip() for c in payments.columns]

# Clean strings
payments['Beneficiary ID'] = payments['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip()
payments['Donor'] = payments['Donor'].astype(str).str.strip()
payments['Status'] = payments['Status'].astype(str).str.strip()

# Clean amount
def clean_amount(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return None
    s = str(x)
    # remove ₹ , commas, spaces
    s = re.sub(r'[^\d.]', '', s)
    return int(s) if s else None

payments['Amount_clean'] = payments['Amount (INR)'].apply(clean_amount)

# Status clean
payments['Status_clean'] = payments['Status'].str.lower()

# Filter paid
payments_paid = payments[payments['Status_clean'] == 'paid'].copy()

# Merge
merged = payments_paid.merge(beneficiaries, on='Beneficiary ID', how='inner')

# Filter donor and gender
mask = (
    (merged['Donor'] == 'Azim Premji Foundation') &
    (merged['Gender'].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Woman')
)

filtered = merged[mask]
total = filtered['Amount_clean'].sum()
print('Rows filtered:', len(filtered))
print('Total sum:', total)
# Show some examples with amount cleaning
print(filtered[['Payment ID','Beneficiary ID','Amount (INR)','Amount_clean','Donor','Gender']].head(20))
